title: चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhima and Yudhishthira return to the fight, and Karna fights Yudhishthira and wounds him with arrows. Yudhishthira, weakened, is carried from the field by his charioteer as Karna and Arjuna come nearer.
summary.kn: ಭೀಮ-ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರರು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಕರ್ಣ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನನ್ನು ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಗಾಯಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಳಲಿದ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನನ್ನು ಸಾರಥಿ ರಣರಂಗದಿಂದ ದೂರ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीम और युधिष्ठिर फिर युद्ध में लौटते हैं, और कर्ण युधिष्ठिर से लड़कर उन्हें बाणों से घायल करता है। कमज़ोर युधिष्ठिर को उनका सारथी रणभूमि से हटा ले जाता है।
summary.te: భీముడు, యుధిష్ఠిరుడు మళ్లీ పోరులోకి వస్తారు; కర్ణుడు యుధిష్ఠిరునితో పోరాడి బాణాలతో గాయపరుస్తాడు. నీరసించిన యుధిష్ఠిరుని సారథి రణభూమి నుండి తీసుకెళతాడు.
summary.ta: பீமனும் யுதிஷ்டிரரும் போருக்குத் திரும்ப, கர்ணன் யுதிஷ்டிரருடன் போரிட்டு அம்புகளால் காயப்படுத்துகிறான். தளர்ந்த யுதிஷ்டிரரைத் தேரோட்டி களத்திலிருந்து அழைத்துச் செல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഭീമനും യുധിഷ്ഠിരനും യുദ്ധത്തിലേക്ക് മടങ്ങിയെത്തുന്നു; കർണ്ണൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് പൊരുതി അമ്പുകളാൽ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ മുറിവേൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ക്ഷീണിതനായ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെ സാരഥി യുദ്ധക്കളത്തിൽനിന്ന് കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു; കർണ്ണനും അർജുനനും അടുത്തടുത്ത് വരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.44; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
निवृत्ते भीमसेने च पाण्डवे च युधिष्ठिरे ।
वध्यमाने बले चापि मामके पाण्डुसृञ्जयैः ॥

meaning.en: When Bhimasena and the Pandava Yudhishthira had turned back, and my army was being slaughtered by the Pandavas and Srinjayas,

verses.text:
द्रवमाणे बलौघे च निराक्रन्दे मुहुर्मुहुः ।
किमकुर्वन्त कुरवस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: and the flood of troops was fleeing, with cries of distress again and again, what did the Kauravas do? Tell me, Sanjaya.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा भीमं महाबाहुं सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।
क्रोधरक्तेक्षणो राजन्भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing mighty-armed Bhima, the powerful charioteer's son Karna, his eyes red with anger, rushed at Bhimasena, O king.

verses.text:
तावकं च बलं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनात्पराङ्मुखम् ।
यत्नेन महता राजन्पर्यवस्थापयद्बली ॥

meaning.en: Seeing your army turn away from Bhimasena, the strong Karna, O king, rallied it with great effort.

verses.text:
व्यवस्थाप्य महाबाहुस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम् ।
प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णः पाण्डवान्युद्धदुर्मदान् ॥

meaning.en: Having steadied your son's host, mighty-armed Karna then advanced against the Pandavas, who were drunk with battle.

verses.text:
प्रत्युद्ययुस्तु राधेयं पाण्डवानां महारथाः ।
धुन्वानाः कार्मुकाण्याजौ विक्षिपन्तश्च सायकान् ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warriors of the Pandavas advanced against Radha's son, shaking their bows and loosing arrows in the fight.

verses.text:
भीमसेनः शिनेर्नप्ता शिखण्डी जनमेजयः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च बलवान्सर्वे चापि प्रभद्रकाः ॥

meaning.en: They were Bhimasena, the grandson of Shini, Shikhandi, Janamejaya, the strong Dhrishtadyumna and all the Prabhadrakas,

verses.text:
पाञ्चालाश्च नरव्याघ्राः समन्तात्तव वाहिनीम् ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धाः समरे जितकाशिनः ॥

meaning.en: and the Panchalas, tigers among men; enraged, victorious in battle, they rushed at your army on all sides.

verses.text:
तथैव तावका राजन्पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् ।
अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता जिघांसन्तो महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way your warriors, great chariot-fighters, rushed eagerly at the Pandava army, wanting to kill.

verses.text:
रथनागाश्वकलिलं पत्तिध्वजसमाकुलम् ।
बभूव पुरुषव्याघ्र सैन्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: The army, thick with chariots, elephants and horses and crowded with foot soldiers and banners, was a wondrous sight, tiger among men.

verses.text:
शिखण्डी च ययौ कर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नः सुतं तव ।
दुःशासनं महाराज महत्या सेनया वृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Shikhandi went against Karna, and Dhrishtadyumna against your son Duhshasana, great king, who was surrounded by a large force.

verses.text:
नकुलो वृषसेनं च चित्रसेनं युधिष्ठिरः ।
उलूकं समरे राजन्सहदेवः समभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Nakula went against Vrishasena, Yudhishthira against Chitrasena, and Sahadeva against Uluka in battle, O king.

verses.text:
सात्यकिः शकुनिं चापि भीमसेनश्च कौरवान् ।
अर्जुनं च रणे यत्तं द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki went against Shakuni, Bhimasena against the Kauravas, and Drona's son, the great warrior, against Arjuna, who stood ready.

verses.text:
युधामन्युं महेष्वासं गौतमोऽभ्यपतद्रणे ।
कृतवर्मा च बलवानुत्तमौजसमाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Kripa, son of Gautama's line, attacked the great archer Yudhamanyu in battle, and the strong Kritavarma rushed at Uttamauja.

verses.text:
भीमसेनः कुरून्सर्वान्पुत्रांश्च तव मारिष ।
सहानीकान्महाबाहुरेक एवाभ्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena alone, mighty-armed, held back all the Kurus and your sons with their armies, sire.

verses.text:
शिखण्डी च ततः कर्णं विचरन्तमभीतवत् ।
भीष्महन्ता महाराज वारयामास पत्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Shikhandi, the slayer of Bhishma, checked Karna with arrows as Karna moved about fearlessly, great king.

verses.text:
प्रतिरब्धस्ततः कर्णो रोषात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः ।
शिखण्डिनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भ्रुवोर्मध्ये व्यताडयत् ॥

meaning.en: Karna, thus blocked, his lip quivering with rage, struck Shikhandi with three arrows between the brows.

verses.text:
धारयंस्तु स तान्बाणाञ्शिखण्डी बह्वशोभत ।
राजतः पर्वतो यद्वत्त्रिभिः शृङ्गैः समन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Bearing those arrows, Shikhandi looked splendid, like a silver mountain with three peaks.

verses.text:
सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः सूतपुत्रेण संयुगे ।
कर्णं विव्याध समरे नवत्या निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Badly wounded by the charioteer's son in battle, the great archer Shikhandi pierced Karna with ninety sharp arrows.

verses.text:
तस्य कर्णो हयान्हत्वा सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः ।
उन्ममाथ ध्वजं चास्य क्षुरप्रेण महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Karna, the great warrior, killed Shikhandi's horses and his charioteer with three arrows and tore down his banner with a razor-headed arrow.

verses.text:
हताश्वात्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः ।
शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय संक्रुद्धः शत्रुतापनः ॥

meaning.en: His horses killed, that great warrior leapt down from his chariot and, furious, scorcher of enemies, hurled a spear at Karna.

verses.text:
तां छित्त्वा समरे कर्णस्त्रिभिर्भारत सायकैः ।
शिखण्डिनमथाविध्यन्नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Karna cut it down in the fight with three arrows, Bharata, and then struck Shikhandi with nine sharp arrows.

verses.text:
कर्णचापच्युतान्बाणान्वर्जयंस्तु नरोत्तमः ।
अपयातस्ततस्तूर्णं शिखण्डी जयतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Avoiding the arrows loosed from Karna's bow, Shikhandi, best of victors, quickly withdrew.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णो महाराज पाण्डुसैन्यान्यशातयत् ।
तूलराशिं समासाद्य यथा वायुर्महाजवः ॥

meaning.en: Then, great king, Karna cut down the Pandava troops, as a very swift wind scatters a heap of cotton.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज तव पुत्रेण पीडितः ।
दुःशासनं त्रिभिर्बाणैरभ्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna, great king, was hard pressed by your son. He pierced Duhshasana in the chest with three arrows.

verses.text:
तस्य दुःशासनो बाहुं सव्यं विव्याध मारिष ।
शितेन रुक्मपुङ्खेन भल्लेन नतपर्वणा ॥

meaning.en: Duhshasana pierced Dhrishtadyumna's left arm, sire, with a sharp, gold-feathered, straight-jointed broad-headed arrow.

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु निर्विद्धः शरं घोरममर्षणः ।
दुःशासनाय संक्रुद्धः प्रेषयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: Wounded, Dhrishtadyumna, unable to bear it, angrily sent a dreadful arrow at Duhshasana, Bharata.

verses.text:
आपतन्तं महावेगं धृष्टद्युम्नसमीरितम् ।
शरैश्चिच्छेद पुत्रस्ते त्रिभिरेव विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Your son cut that very swift arrow, sent by Dhrishtadyumna, as it came, using just three arrows, lord of men.

verses.text:
अथापरैः सप्तदशैर्भल्लैः कनकभूषणैः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नं समासाद्य बाह्वोरुरसि चार्दयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, with seventeen other gold-adorned broad-headed arrows, he reached Dhrishtadyumna and hurt his arms and chest.

verses.text:
ततः स पार्षतः क्रुद्धो धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष ।
क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the angry son of Prishata cut Duhshasana's bow with a very sharp razor-headed arrow, sire, and the people shouted aloud.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ ।
धृष्टद्युम्नं शरव्रातैः समन्तात्पर्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Taking up another bow, your son, best of Bharatas, surrounded Dhrishtadyumna on every side with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
तव पुत्रस्य ते दृष्ट्वा विक्रमं तं महात्मनः ।
व्यहसन्त रणे योधाः सिद्धाश्चाप्सरसां गणाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the prowess of your high-souled son, the warriors laughed in the battle, and the Siddhas and bands of Apsaras too.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तावकानां परैः सह ।
घोरं प्राणभृतां काले घोररूपं परंतप ॥

meaning.en: Then the fighting between your men and the enemy broke out, dreadful and terrible, at a time when lives were being lost, scorcher of foes.

verses.text:
नकुलं वृषसेनस्तु विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिरायसैः ।
पितुः समीपे तिष्ठन्तं त्रिभिरन्यैरविध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Vrishasena pierced Nakula with five iron arrows, and, as Nakula stood near his father, with three more.

verses.text:
नकुलस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो वृषसेनं स्मयन्निव ।
नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन विव्याध हृदये दृढम् ॥

meaning.en: Nakula, angry, as if smiling, struck Vrishasena firmly in the heart with a very sharp iron arrow.

verses.text:
सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुकर्शनः ।
शत्रुं विव्याध विंशत्या स च तं पञ्चभिः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Deeply wounded by his strong enemy, that destroyer of foes pierced his enemy with twenty arrows, and Vrishasena struck him with five.

verses.text:
ततः शरसहस्रेण तावुभौ पुरुषर्षभौ ।
अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतामथाभज्यत वाहिनी ॥

meaning.en: Then those two bulls among men covered each other with a thousand arrows, and the army broke apart.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा तु प्रद्रुतां सेनां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सूतजः ।
निवारयामास बलादनुपत्य विशां पते ।
निवृत्ते तु ततः कर्णे नकुलः कौरवान्ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Dhritarashtra's son's army in flight, the charioteer's son followed up and forced it to turn back, lord of men. When Karna turned back, Nakula went off against the Kauravas.

verses.text:
कर्णपुत्रस्तु समरे हित्वा नकुलमेव तु ।
जुगोप चक्रं त्वरितं राधेयस्यैव मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Karna's son, leaving Nakula alone in the battle, quickly guarded the wheel of Radha's son, sire.

verses.text:
उलूकस्तु रणे क्रुद्धः सहदेवेन वारितः ।
तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सहदेवः प्रतापवान् ।
सारथिं प्रेषयामास यमस्य सदनं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Uluka, angry in battle, was stopped by Sahadeva. The mighty Sahadeva killed his four horses and sent his charioteer to the house of Yama.

verses.text:
उलूकस्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य विशां पते ।
त्रिगर्तानां बलं पूर्णं जगाम पितृनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Then Uluka, the son who delights his father, leapt down from his chariot, lord of men, and went to the full force of the Trigartas.

verses.text:
सात्यकिः शकुनिं विद्ध्वा विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः ।
ध्वजं चिच्छेद भल्लेन सौबलस्य हसन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki pierced Shakuni with twenty sharp arrows and, as if laughing, cut down his banner with a broad-headed arrow.

verses.text:
सौबलस्तस्य समरे क्रुद्धो राजन्प्रतापवान् ।
विदार्य कवचं भूयो ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्चनम् ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni, the son of Subala, powerful and angry in battle, O king, pierced Satyaki's armor and again cut down his golden banner.

verses.text:
अथैनं निशितैर्बाणैः सात्यकिः प्रत्यविध्यत ।
सारथिं च महाराज त्रिभिरेव समार्दयत् ।
अथास्य वाहांस्त्वरितः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki struck him with sharp arrows, and with just three he hurt Shakuni's charioteer, great king, and quickly sent his horses to Yama's abode with arrows.

verses.text:
ततोऽवप्लुत्य सहसा शकुनिर्भरतर्षभ ।
आरुरोह रथं तूर्णमुलूकस्य महारथः ।
अपोवाहाथ शीघ्रं स शैनेयाद्युद्धशालिनः ॥

meaning.en: Then suddenly Shakuni, best of Bharatas, leapt down and quickly climbed onto the chariot of Uluka, the great warrior, and swiftly bore himself away from Satyaki, the Shini warrior.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु रणे राजंस्तावकानामनीकिनीम् ।
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन ततोऽनीकमभिद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, O king, then rushed with speed at your army in the battle, and the host was broken.

verses.text:
शैनेयशरनुन्नं तु ततः सैन्यं विशां पते ।
भेजे दश दिशस्तूर्णं न्यपतच्च गतासुवत् ॥

meaning.en: Driven by the arrows of the Shini hero, the army scattered quickly in the ten directions, lord of men, and fell like men without life.

verses.text:
भीमसेनं तव सुतो वारयामास संयुगे ।
तं तु भीमो मुहूर्तेन व्यश्वसूतरथध्वजम् ।
चक्रे लोकेश्वरं तत्र तेनातुष्यन्त चारणाः ॥

meaning.en: Your son held back Bhimasena in the fight. But in a moment Bhima left that lord of the world without chariot, horses, charioteer or banner, and the bards were pleased by it.

verses.text:
ततोऽपायान्नृपस्तत्र भीमसेनस्य गोचरात् ।
कुरुसैन्यं ततः सर्वं भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् ।
तत्र रावो महानासीद्भीममेकं जिघांसताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the king slipped away out of Bhimasena's reach, and the whole Kuru army rushed at Bhimasena. A great uproar rose among those who wished to kill Bhima alone.

verses.text:
युधामन्युः कृपं विद्ध्वा धनुरस्याशु चिच्छिदे ।
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय कृपः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhamanyu pierced Kripa and quickly cut his bow. Then Kripa, best of weapon-bearers, took up another bow,

verses.text:
युधामन्योर्ध्वजं सूतं छत्रं चापातयत्क्षितौ ।
ततोऽपायाद्रथेनैव युधामन्युर्महारथः ॥

meaning.en: and felled Yudhamanyu's banner, charioteer and parasol to the ground. Then the great warrior Yudhamanyu withdrew on that same chariot.

verses.text:
उत्तमौजास्तु हार्दिक्यं शरैर्भीमपराक्रमम् ।
छादयामास सहसा मेघो वृष्ट्या यथाचलम् ॥

meaning.en: Uttamauja suddenly covered Kritavarma, Hridika's son, of terrible prowess, with arrows, as a cloud covers a mountain with rain.

verses.text:
तद्युद्धं सुमहच्चासीद्घोररूपं परंतप ।
यादृशं न मया युद्धं दृष्टपूर्वं विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: That battle was very great and dreadful, scorcher of foes, such as I have never seen before, lord of men.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा ततो राजन्नुत्तमौजसमाहवे ।
हृदि विव्याध स तदा रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, Kritavarma pierced Uttamauja in the heart in the fight, and Uttamauja sank down on the chariot platform.

verses.text:
सारथिस्तमपोवाह रथेन रथिनां वरम् ।
ततस्तु सत्वरं राजन्पाण्डुसैन्यमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: His charioteer carried that best of chariot-fighters away from there, and then Kritavarma swiftly attacked the Pandava army.
